newsitem.title: USA: Pa. 600 MW Homer City coal unit seen back Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Pa. 600 MW Homer City coal unit seen back Thursday.

text.p: A 600 megawatt (MW) unit at the coal-fired Homer City, Pa., generating station was expected to resume operation Thursday after being shut Monday, the operator GPU Generation Inc said.
Homer City's unit 2 was shut to repair an oil feed pump, a company spokeswoman said Tuesday.
Pennsylvania Electric Co (Penelec) and New York Electric & Gas Corp, each have 50 percent stake in Homer City 2.
Both Penelec and GPU Generation are subsidiaries of GPU Inc of Parsippany, N.J.
